Graduate Admissions Requirements
Arkansas State University welcomes motivated learners from all over to pursue graduate
study. Whether you're applying for a master’s or doctoral program, you’ll find the
minimum admission requirements, important considerations, and clear steps to get started.
General Admission Requirements
Unconditional Admission Status
To be considered for a graduate degree program, you must meet the Graduate School’s
minimum admission requirements. For unconditional admission, you must:
Submit a completed online application for admission with the required program documents
by the deadline on the department website.
Pay the nonrefundable application fee of $30 for U.S. Applicants, $50 for International
Applicants, or $50 for Doctoral Applicants to Graduate School Admissions.
Have a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution (or its equivalent as determined
by the Graduate School) with a minimum cumulative undergraduate grade point average
of 2.75 on a 4.00 scale or a 3.00 GPA in the last 60 hours.
Achieve a minimum 3.00 GPA on any previous graduate courses completed at either Arkansas
State University or another accredited university.
Submit ofﬁcial transcripts from each college or university as requested by the Graduate
School. Ofﬁcial transcripts must be submitted directly from the registrar of other
institutions to the ofﬁce of the Graduate School at Arkansas State University.
Conditional Admission Status
If you don’t meet the GPA requirements, have an unrelated undergraduate degree, or
graduated from an unaccredited school, you may still qualify for conditional admission
if:
Submit a completed online application for admission with the required program documents
by the deadline on the department website.
Pay the nonrefundable application fee of $30 for U.S. Applicants, $50 for International
Applicants, or $50 for Doctoral Applicants to Graduate School Admissions.
Submit ofﬁcial transcripts from each college or university as requested by the Graduate
School. Ofﬁcial transcripts must be submitted directly from the registrar of other
institutions to the ofﬁce of the Graduate School at Arkansas State University.
Achieve a minimum cumulative undergraduate grade point average of 2.50 on a 4.00 scale
or a 2.75 GPA on the last 60 hours for admission into a graduate program or for admission
as a non-degree student.
Program Admission Criteria
Some programs have specific requirements for admissions. Meeting the minimum requirements
for admission to the Graduate School does not necessarily ensure acceptance into a
particular graduate degree program. Be sure to check with your program.
